build_transformer_model: build a Transformer encoder-decoder model using TransformerModel.build_model with args and task
build_transformer_encoder: build a TransformerEncoder with specified args, source dictionary, and token embeddings
build_transformer_decoder: build a TransformerDecoder with specified args, target dictionary, and token embeddings
run_transformer_forward: run the forward pass through the TransformerModel with source tokens and previous output tokens
configure_transformer_architecture: configure a Transformer model architecture using base_architecture or preset variants like transformer_wmt_en_de
